page_title.en: Two Moons — Compare Two Stories: Same & Different (Grade 1)
page_title.de: Zwei Geschichten vergleichen: Gleich & Anders finden

page_intro.en: A free interactive Grade 1 reading activity: read two short tales with Mossbeard the Story-Keeper, then compare what happened to the characters across both stories — tap what is the SAME in both, or what happened in ONLY ONE. A friendly first look at comparing and contrasting characters' experiences across stories. Common Core RL.1.9.
page_intro.de: Vergleiche zwei kurze Geschichten und erkenne, was gleich ist und was anders: kostenlos, interaktiv und ohne Zeitdruck – Lesen üben in der Grundschule.
